metrics_cases_active_description: Every unresolved issue, counted once, whatever record it affects.
metrics_cases_active_time_semantics: Counts unresolved issues, and what they wait for, at the time shown.
metrics_cases_attention_description: Unresolved issues waiting for an approval, a manual fix, or a review of an unclear outcome. Each issue counts under one reason.
metrics_cases_attention_time_semantics: Counts unresolved issues, and what they wait for, at the time shown.
metrics_cases_oldest_unresolved_age_desc: Time since the oldest unresolved issue was first detected. A reopened issue keeps its first detection time. Missing or future detection times count as unknown.
metrics_cases_oldest_unresolved_age_time: Counts unresolved issues, and what they wait for, at the time shown.
metrics_orders_open_description: Orders with fulfillment work remaining. Partially fulfilled orders count once. Completed, canceled, and deleted orders don’t count.
metrics_orders_open_time_semantics: Order data from your connected systems at the time shown.
metrics_orders_overdue_description: Open orders whose fulfillment deadline from the source system has passed. Orders without a deadline count as unknown.
metrics_orders_overdue_time_semantics: Deadlines before the time shown. The count can change as time passes, even without new data.
metrics_orders_attention_description: Orders linked to an unresolved issue that waits for an approval, a manual fix, or a review of an unclear outcome. Each order counts once.
metrics_orders_attention_time_semantics: Issues and order data from the same moment, at the time shown.
metrics_procurement_purchase_orders_draf: Purchase orders in Luma that are still drafts.
Purchase order status at the time shown.
metrics_procurement_purchase_orders_open: Open purchase orders recorded in Luma. Open doesn’t mean the supplier received or accepted the order.
Purchase order status at the time shown.
metrics_inventory_below_minimum_descript: Stock positions with an active replenishment rule whose stock is below the minimum. Draft or open purchase orders for the same SKU, from any supplier, are shown, but don’t prove that enough stock is on its way.
metrics_inventory_below_minimum_time_sem: Stock from the chosen connection must be less than 5 minutes old at the time shown. Stock equal to the minimum isn’t below it.
metrics_inventory_replenishment_unknown_: Stock positions with an active replenishment rule whose stock from the chosen connection is missing, deleted, not a number, dated in the future, or out of date.
Stock from the chosen connection must be less than 5 minutes old at the time shown. Stock equal to the minimum isn’t below it.
metrics_connections_needing_attention_de: Connections that are pending, degraded, or revoked, or whose allowed reads are out of date or haven’t run yet. Disconnected connections don’t count. Each connection counts once.
metrics_connections_needing_attention_ti: Connection health and allowed reads at the time shown. Data exactly 24 hours old still counts as current.
metrics_resolution_unknown_eligibility_d: Issues with no recorded check of whether Luma may resolve them on its own.
metrics_resolution_unknown_eligibility_t: Issues first detected in the selected period before the time shown, with their outcome at that time. Shows live issues from the last 7 days unless you choose otherwise. Retries don’t add issues.
metrics_resolution_eligible_description: Issues checked and found eligible for automatic resolution under a recorded rule version.
metrics_resolution_eligible_time_semanti: Issues first detected in the selected period before the time shown, with their outcome at that time. Shows live issues from the last 7 days unless you choose otherwise. Retries don’t add issues.
metrics_resolution_verified_description: Issues whose current outcome was confirmed by a complete, independent check. A repeated problem opens a new linked issue. Earlier verified outcomes stay as evidence.
metrics_resolution_verified_time_semanti: Issues first detected in the selected period before the time shown, with their outcome at that time. Shows live issues from the last 7 days unless you choose otherwise. Retries don’t add issues.
metrics_resolution_autonomous_descriptio: Eligible, verified issues with a complete record showing nobody approved, repaired, or corrected anything.
metrics_resolution_autonomous_time_seman: Issues first detected in the selected period before the time shown, with their outcome at that time. Shows live issues from the last 7 days unless you choose otherwise. Retries don’t add issues.
metrics_resolution_human_description: Issues where a person approved, repaired, corrected, or closed something, across every attempt.
metrics_resolution_human_time_semantics: Issues first detected in the selected period before the time shown, with their outcome at that time. Shows live issues from the last 7 days unless you choose otherwise. Retries don’t add issues.
metrics_resolution_unknown_description: Issues without a complete record of who acted before the current outcome.
metrics_resolution_unknown_time_semantic: Issues first detected in the selected period before the time shown, with their outcome at that time. Shows live issues from the last 7 days unless you choose otherwise. Retries don’t add issues.
metrics_resolution_pending_description: Issues without a current independently verified outcome, including issues a person closed.
metrics_resolution_pending_time_semantic: Issues first detected in the selected period before the time shown, with their outcome at that time. Shows live issues from the last 7 days unless you choose otherwise. Retries don’t add issues.
metrics_resolution_recurrent_description: New issues linked to an earlier one. Each recurrence counts separately.
metrics_resolution_recurrent_time_semant: Issues first detected in the selected period before the time shown, with their outcome at that time. Shows live issues from the last 7 days unless you choose otherwise. Retries don’t add issues.
metrics_resolution_incorrect_actions_des: Issues where evidence shows an action was wrong. A failed action alone doesn’t count as incorrect.
metrics_resolution_incorrect_actions_tim: Issues first detected in the selected period before the time shown, with their outcome at that time. Shows live issues from the last 7 days unless you choose otherwise. Retries don’t add issues.
metrics_resolution_time_to_outcome_descr: Median time from first detection to the current independent check, across all attempts.
metrics_resolution_time_to_outcome_time_: Issues first detected in the selected period before the time shown, with their outcome at that time. Shows live issues from the last 7 days unless you choose otherwise. Retries don’t add issues.
metrics_resolution_unresolved_age_descri: Longest time since first detection among issues still waiting for an independent check.
metrics_resolution_unresolved_age_time_s: Issues first detected in the selected period before the time shown, with their outcome at that time. Shows live issues from the last 7 days unless you choose otherwise. Retries don’t add issues.
